areas.name: Bands & Ensembles
areas.tagline: Marching, concert, jazz, choral & chamber groups
areas.description: From the Auburn University Marching Band to jazz combos, chamber groups, choirs, and orchestra, Auburn's ensembles are open to music majors and non-majors alike — find your group and get playing.

areas.name: Brass
areas.description: Brass students study applied performance within Auburn's Bachelor of Music instrumental track, with private lessons, studio classes, and placement in Auburn's bands, orchestra, and jazz ensembles.

areas.name: Woodwind & Percussion
areas.tagline: Flute, clarinet, saxophone, oboe, bassoon & percussion
areas.description: Woodwind and percussion majors pursue a Bachelor of Music in Instrumental Performance, combining private study with ensemble placement across Auburn's concert bands, orchestra, and jazz program.

areas.name: Voice
areas.description: Vocal Performance students earn a Bachelor of Music built around private voice lessons, diction and vocal pedagogy coursework, and performance opportunities with Auburn's choirs and opera workshop.

areas.name: Piano
areas.description: Piano majors complete a Bachelor of Music focused on solo performance, collaborative piano, and pedagogy, with regular studio recitals and the annual Concerto Competition.

areas.name: Commercial Music
areas.tagline: Modern performance, production & the music business
areas.description: The Commercial Music degree blends contemporary performance with recording, production, and the business side of the music industry — including access to Auburn's Lucky Man Studio and Commercial Ensembles.

areas.name: Composition & Technology
areas.description: Composition (Technology) students write original concert, media, and electronic music while building skills in notation software, digital audio workstations, and recording technology.

areas.name: Music Education
areas.tagline: Become an instrumental or vocal music teacher
areas.description: Offered with Auburn's College of Education, the Bachelor of Music Education prepares instrumental, vocal, or combined-track teachers and is approved by the Alabama State Board of Education and CAEP.

hotspots.title: ATC Monitors
hotspots.body: The room is monitored on **ATC SCM45** left/center/right reference monitors — the same uncolored, trusted-in-professional-rooms standard used across the industry.

hotspots.title: Mixing Console
hotspots.body: Hands-on console time, patched straight into the studio's outboard chain of vintage-style Neve, SSL, and API-style processing — students learn the workflow the way working engineers do.

hotspots.title: Arturia PolyBrute
hotspots.body: One of the studio's **Arturia PolyBrute** analog synthesizers, alongside a Waldorf Iridium and Yamaha Montage — hands-on sound design for composition and production students.

hotspots.title: Outboard Gear
hotspots.body: A rack of outboard processors, including vintage-style tube compressors modeled on the legendary Fairchild 670 — patched in for tracking and mixing sessions.

department.name: Department of Music
department.heroTitle: Be a Part of the Music.
department.heroSub: Eight programs, one Auburn stage. Tap one to step in.
